page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.large is a general-purpose instance type belonging to the Enhanced g6t family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a nominal clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Compute capacity is delivered through 2 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 8.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Storage and acceleration configurations are baseline. The instance contains no bundled local storage, requiring persistent workloads to utilize remote cloud disk volumes. It operates without discrete graphics hardware, listing a GPU count of zero. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are allocated to the instance by default.

The balance between compute and memory makes the ecs.g6t.large appropriate for consistent general-purpose compute demands. Primary workload targets include web application servers, containerized microservices, build nodes in continuous integration pipelines, and small to medium transactional databases.

With dedicated compute resources and a balanced resource profile, ecs.g6t.large serves general-purpose business applications, middle-tier services, web serving setups, and light database environments.
